statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir=${cwd/#$HOME/\~}; blue=$(printf '\033[34m'); red=$(printf '\033[31m'); green=$(printf '\033[32m'); reset=$(printf '\033[0m'); out="${blue}${dir}${reset}"; if git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks describe --tags --exact-match HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$branch" ]; then out="${out} ${red} ${branch}"; if git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then out="${out} ${green}✓${reset}"; else out="${out} ${red}●${reset}"; fi; fi; fi; out="${out} ${blue}➤${reset} "; printf '%s' "$out"
